gloss: cram school director; private school head

definitions.gloss: cram school director; head of a private academy; juku director
definitions.explanation: The head or director of a juku (private tutoring school or cram school). Can also refer to the head of other types of private academies, such as martial arts dojos or traditional schools of learning.

examples.japanese: {塾長|じゅくちょう}が{直接|ちょくせつ}{指導|しどう}する{授業|じゅぎょう}がある。
examples.english: There are classes taught directly by the cram school director.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{塾長|じゅくちょう}は{保護者|ほごしゃ}との{面談|めんだん}を{大切|たいせつ}にしている。
examples.english: The new cram school director values meetings with parents.

examples.japanese: {塾長|じゅくちょう}は{三十年|さんじゅうねん}の{教育|きょういく}{経験|けいけん}を{持|も}ち、{地域|ちいき}の{子|こ}どもたちの{学力|がくりょく}{向上|こうじょう}に{貢献|こうけん}してきた。
examples.english: The school director has thirty years of teaching experience and has contributed to improving the academic abilities of children in the area.

notes:
Compound of {塾|じゅく} ('cram school; private academy') and {長|ちょう} ('head; chief'). Follows the standard {〜長|ちょう} pattern for leadership titles: {校長|こうちょう} ('school principal'), {社長|しゃちょう} ('company president'), {部長|ぶちょう} ('department head').

USAGE:
- Most commonly refers to the owner-operator of a {学習塾|がくしゅうじゅく} (academic cram school)
- Can also apply to the head of a {道場|どうじょう}-style academy or a historical {私塾|しじゅく} (private school)
- In historical contexts, refers to the head of famous private schools like {慶應義塾|けいおうぎじゅく} (Keio University's predecessor)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塾長|じゅくちょう}を{務|つと}める: to serve as cram school director
- {塾長|じゅくちょう}の{方針|ほうしん}: the director's policy
- {塾長|じゅくちょう}{自|みずか}ら: the director personally
- {塾長|じゅくちょう}{挨拶|あいさつ}: greeting from the director

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {校長|こうちょう}: school principal — the head of a formal public or private school
- {講師|こうし}: instructor; lecturer — a person who teaches, but not necessarily the head
- {塾|じゅく}: cram school — the institution itself, not the person who runs it
